mapper.sql: id, user_id, answers_json, stage, mbti, profile_path, profile_json, summary, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into assessment_record (user_id, answers_json, stage, mbti, profile_path, profile_json, summary, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{answersJson}, #{stage}, #{mbti}, #{profilePath}, #{profileJson}, #{summary}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select from assessment_record where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update assessment_record set summary = #{summary}, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
